display.purpose: Main page titles and command deck headings.

body.purpose: Form fields, list text, and general prose.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button with responsive scale and primary command glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 20px -4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); background-color: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: transparent; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6); border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: Crime OS AI is styled as a state-of-the-art threat intelligence console rather than a traditional government database form. It balances high-tech cyber-command aesthetics with immediate, low-friction task interfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-Mode-First Environment: Deploys a deep navy/slate canvas (#0B0F19)
AI Transparency & Grounding: Partition AI suggestions visually

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary Electric Command Blue is used on <=10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Glow-on-Demand Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. Glow effects appear only on hover/active states or AI items.

dos: Do wrap every AI recommendation or prediction in an AiContentCard with an explicit Sparkle badge.
Do format all dates, account details, and numeric markers in JetBrains Mono.
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders on non-AI cards.
Don't use warm, sand-colored, or beige backgrounds.
